author: smcarus
title: Will Brazil's reserves cover more months of imports in 2026 than in 2025?
summary: Give the probability that the World Bank's reserves in months of imports for Brazil is higher for 2026 than for 2025, both as first read on or after 1 September 2027.
knownLimits: The World Bank may not have published 2026 by the settle date; then the Quest is Unresolvable.
Both years are read from the same download, so a revision to 2025 counts.
